verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents registrable webhooks: users pick specific events and Ironclad automatically POSTs to a URL when they occur, managed through the UI or API. That is a product-native event-to-action rule, but the only built-in action is an HTTP callback. Any further action logic, such as blocking or advancing approvals, has to be built in the user's own integration. missing for 10: a documented in-product rules engine with conditions and native actions (e.g. Workflow Designer conditional triggers), action types beyond outbound POST, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Webhooks allow you to specify that we should POST to your URL when certain events happen.
Creates a webhook for the specified events.
it is possible to create and retrieve webhooks in the UI and through the API
